days.title: Arrival
days.card: You arrived in Yaba. ₦600,000 and an empty plot.
days.baba: Ẹ káàbọ̀, my son! Welcome to Yaba. I am Baba, your neighbour. Start with one room.

days.title: Move in
days.card: Home! Your first night under your own roof.
days.baba: Go inside, my son. Make it yours.
days.journal: NEPA took light, but my room stayed cool.

days.title: Love
days.card: You met Adaeze at the buka. ♥
days.baba: Ah! I saw you at the buka. She has a good laugh, that one.
days.journal: Adaeze moved in. Our first dinner together.

days.title: Family
days.baba: A baby! The nursery must stay cool, o. Babies feel the heat first.
days.journal: Tolu sleeps in a cool room.

days.title: Hustle
days.card: Adaeze opens a small food spot.
days.baba: Her jollof will bring the whole street. Build her a spot by the road.
days.journal: The food spot is open. Customers queue already.

days.title: Growing
days.baba: Tolu plays like a small Okocha! Your family needs more space. Build upward.
days.journal: A second floor, a roof garden, and homework done.

days.title: Making it big
days.card: The family business is the talk of Yaba.
days.baba: Look at what your hands have built, my son.
days.journal: Ẹ ku ilé o! A house full of family and friends.
